title: Dynamic-programming initialization
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean-valued tapes, let $c,B,e$ be natural numbers, and let $x$ be a Boolean list. Return an encoding whose first component is the context associated to $c,B,e,x$ and whose second component is obtained by applying the initial-entry operation to the list formed from that context and the codes associated to $B,e,x$.
hypotheses_covered: N is a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over Bool
c, B, and e are natural numbers
caveat: The payload does not include definitions of the context, code list, encoding, or list mapping.
